Health Functional FoodManganese 1.07mgVitamin A 250μgVitamin B1 0.5mgVitamin B6 0.84mgVitamin C 100mgVitamin D 2.5μgVitamin E 5.4mgZinc 6.35mgFolate 128μgOnce a day

데일리밸런스Manganese · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Zinc · Folate

Made by (주)유유헬스케어 · Once a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 1.07mg of Manganese, 250μg of Vitamin A, 0.5mg of Vitamin B1, 0.84mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 2.5μg of Vitamin D, 5.4mg of Vitamin E, 6.35mg of Zinc, 128μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 tablets): 1.07mg Manganese, 250μg Vitamin A, 0.5mg Vitamin B1, 0.84mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 2.5μg Vitamin D, 5.4mg Vitamin E, 6.35mg Zinc, 128μg Folate
  • Made by (주)유유헬스케어

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day2 tablets per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Manganese labelled (1.07mg / 1400mg), 80~150%
Vitamin A labelled (250μg / 1400mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (0.5mg / 1400mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (0.84mg / 1400mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (100mg / 1400mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (2.5μg / 1400mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (5.4mg / 1400mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (6.35mg / 1400mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (128μg / 1400mg), 80~150%
Appearance 이미, 이취가 없고 고유의 향미가 있는 미황색의 장방형 정제
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage ① 직사광선을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. ② 병포장의 경우 제품 개봉 후 보관시 흡습방지를 위해 뚜껑을 꼭 닫아야 함.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Manganese · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Zinc · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
